responsibility: This machine-description support file defines the reusable mode iterators, code iterators, integer iterators, and derived attributes that parameterize the AArch64 RTL patterns spread across aarch64.md, aarch64-simd.md, aarch64-sve.md, and related fragments. It is the backend’s shared vocabulary for pattern generation over scalar, AdvSIMD, SVE, predicate, and condition-code modes, as well as for unspec-driven naming and operand-attribute selection, allowing large families of instruction patterns and builtin mappings to be generated compactly and consistently from common iterator sets.
